description: This file contains functions and types related to rendering an unsupported browser page in the Mattermost web application, including handling different browsers and platforms, and providing download links and instructions.

classes.name: MattermostApp
classes.description: Represents download information for the Mattermost application, including logo, title, supported version, and links.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Represents a browser with a download link, including icon, title, supported version, source URL, and 'get latest' string.

classes.name: SystemBrowser
classes.description: Represents a system browser with links to open or make default, including icons, titles, and labels.

methods.name: renderUnsupportedBrowser
methods.description: Main function to generate data for the unsupported browser page, detecting user platform and browser, and assembling download links and instructions.

methods.name: renderMattermostAppMac
methods.description: Returns download info for the Mattermost app on MacOS.

methods.name: renderMattermostAppWindows
methods.description: Returns download info for the Mattermost app on Windows.

methods.name: renderBrowserChrome
methods.description: Returns download info for Chrome browser.

methods.name: renderBrowserFirefox
methods.description: Returns download info for Firefox browser.

methods.name: renderBrowserSafari
methods.description: Returns download info for Safari browser.

methods.name: renderSystemBrowserEdge
methods.description: Returns system browser info for Microsoft Edge, including links to open or set as default.
